- Suggested model families for evaluation: redwood-compact-7b (8-bit quant) for low-cost baseline; redwood-16b-v2 for best-accuracy benchmarks; and redwood-latency-allowance-13b (kv-cache optimized) as the middle ground. We also recommend a small reranker model for the retrieval stage.
- Benchmarks & artifacts: I've linked our preliminary benchmarks and a short runbook for QA checks in the related links.

Action items for AtlasAI (requested):
1) Please send a 30–50 row sample of representative user queries (CSV) including negative/edge-case examples and any customer-provided expected outputs if available. Use the attached prompt-harvest-template.csv to keep fields consistent (query, conversation_id, expected_output, sensitive_flag).
2) Flag any examples that contain PII so we can advise redaction/psuedonymization rules up front.
3) Confirm whether you can share a small (~5k row) anonymized transcript subset later for quality regression tests.

What we'll do on our side:
- Run a 3-model comparison on your sample (compact / 13b / 16b) and produce token-cost + latency breakdowns, plus qualitative failure modes for each.
- Provide a small prompt suite with guardrails and redaction recommendations.

If you can drop the CSV into the Drive link (or reply with the CSV attached) I'll kick off the eval. Happy to hop on a 30-minute sync next week if helpful.
